issue.title: Offering fuzz targets for the PAX/OCI, ARP/IPv4/ICMP and volume-format parsers

body_verbatim:
While independently reviewing ginux@82df3d71, I built libFuzzer harnesses for three untrusted-input surfaces and would like to offer them upstream:
- crates/oci tar+PAX (parse plus the traversal APIs used by published_rootfs.rs): 41.0M execs, 93.2% regions
- crates/protocol-state ARP/IPv4/ICMP: 247.1M execs, 97.5% regions
- crates/volume-format sectors: 87.8M execs, 99.4% regions
- a 15.3M-exec differential run of the PAX parser against the tar crate: all differences were fail-closed
All runs use ASan and overflow-checks, committed seeds and dictionaries; no crashes or sanitizer reports. Fuzzing only finds crashes, not logic bugs, so this is not a safety claim. The harnesses are in hafid-logic/ginux-watch (fuzz/) and consume upstream read-only at the pinned commit.
Would you prefer them under fuzz/ or tests/? A draft PR can follow if useful.
(AI-assisted analysis, reviewed by me.)
